name: PowerClean
decision: Attributed application foundation; unsafe inherited actions removed or restricted.

name: BCUninstaller
decision: Startup approval mapping/state encoding adapted with copyright and license; backups added independently.

name: TrafficMonitor
decision: Compact-monitor presentation reference. Own native layered renderer; no code copied.

name: Mem Reduct
decision: Memory-purge behavior reviewed. Global memory-list purges rejected; guarded per-process trimming retained.

name: BleachBit
decision: Cleanup actions/browser definitions reviewed. Own closed-browser disposable-cache plan; cookie/session/offline cleanup excluded.

name: WinDirStat
decision: Disk-tree work reviewed. Own iterative scan with session-local counters and bounded memory; no code copied.

name: WinUtil
decision: Maintenance/startup practices reviewed. No remote bootstrap scripts or blanket service disabling adopted.
